mentions.name: Reviewskits
mentions.description: Reviewskits is an open-source, unified platform for collecting all customer sentiment, starting with a headless testimonial engine. It offers clean APIs and SDKs for React, Vue, and Svelte so teams keep 100% control over the UI instead of embedding heavy iframe widgets, and it can be self-hosted to own your data or used as a managed cloud service. The roadmap consolidates testimonials with feature requests and feedback loops to replace multiple separate feedback tools.
mentions.problem: Startups typically use 3+ different tools (e.g. Senja/Testimonial.to for testimonials, Canny for feature voting, another for bug reports), resulting in fragmented data and a mess of different invoices.
mentions.audience: Startups and dev-first teams that need to manage user feedback
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building Reviewskits (https://reviewskits.com).

Most startups today use 3+ different tools to manage user feedback: one for testimonials (Senja/Testimonial.to), one for feature voting (Canny), and another for bug reports. It’s a mess of different invoices and fragmented data.

We are building a unified platform for all customer sentiment, starting with a headless testimonial engine.
